decisive_items: Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
response.rationale: R3 is more specific to the symptoms and OCT findings of phototoxic maculopathy caused by high-intensity LED light exposure, while R2 is a more general diagnosis of photoreceptor damage

rejected.why: lack of direct evidence for solar retinopathy
